metadata.case_name: TSANG HIN CHEUNG v. NG KIT YEUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: parking and cleaning vehicles at a car sales yard (Chun Lee Motor Company)

injuries.description: Comminuted fracture of the right distal radius and ulna
source: The Plaintiff suffered a comminuted fracture of the right distal radius and ulna. An open reduction and internal fixation was performed.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of both ulna and radius

manifestations.description: Impaired range of motion at the time of examination (5% reported by Dr Chan; 3% assessed by Dr Tsoi)
Residual pain of the right forearm and wrist, especially on supination
Cannot carry objects exceeding 15 kg for more than 15 minutes due to weakness and tiredness in forearm/hand
Difficulty in returning to pre-accident duty as a lorry driver-cum-manual worker (as noted by Dr Chan)

treatments_received: Open reduction and internal fixation (operation performed on 2002-02-15)
Placement in a long arm hinged brace

losses.description: Impaired function of right forearm and wrist (reduced ROM, weak grip, residual pain) caused by fracture of right distal radius and ulna

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to play badminton and squash after the accident
Claim that he could no longer work as a hair-stylist because his hand was too weak to use scissors smoothly

comparable_cases.case_name: Chung Hok Sung v. Li Kam Ming
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture resulting from a fall. An open reduction and internal fixations were performed. He was given 4½ months sick leave. For a year after the accident, he could not hold or carry any objects, but later he should have been able to return to his former work as a labour worker.
